fullContentHtml:
RUHS Medical Officer Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan University of Health Sciences (RUHS) has released the notification for the Medical Officer Posts. This recruitment has been issued for 600 posts. The online application process for RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 has started from 14 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 13 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 September 2026
  • Last Date : 13 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 13 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 13 December 2026
  • Admit Card : 08 December 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 5000/-
  • SC, ST (For Rajasthan State) : Rs. 2500/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is RUHS Medical Officer Online Form 2026?

RUHS Medical Officer Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
